sources.entry: Tine - Software for digital collaboration in companies and organizations. From powerful groupware functionalities to clever add-ons, tine combines everything to make daily team collaboration easier. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Tine is a groupware suite for companies and organizations, delivered as OCI container images with an AGPLv3 core and a paid business edition.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes tine as a set of integrated groupware services shipped as OCI images, aimed at daily team collaboration. It lists sync and client compatibility with ActiveSync (iOS, Android), WebDAV (Windows Explorer, macOS Finder, KDE, Gnome), CalDAV (Thunderbird, iCal, DAVx5) and CardDAV (macOS/iOS Contacts, CardBook, DAVx5). The stated server stack is PHP 8.2 to 8.5 with MySQL or MariaDB, plus Apache or Nginx, and Redis or Valkey. A quick-start guide covers on-premise evaluation, and the vendor offers SaaS hosting. The README does not detail individual feature modules beyond the general groupware and add-on description.
use_cases: syncing contacts and calendars with mobile devices
WebDAV file access from desktop clients
how_to_run: Follow the quick-start guide linked from the README to run an evaluation copy on premise (services are provided as OCI images).
For a development build from source, use the tine-dev setup described in the linked repo (not suited for production).
notable: Supports standard sync protocols (ActiveSync, CalDAV, CardDAV, WebDAV) with a listed set of tested clients
Open-core model: community edition under AGPLv3, with a business edition license for more users and add-ons
Free use of the business edition for up to five users without a license key
Vendor holds copyright on tine-specific code, which allows alternative licensing
caveats: Beyond five users, a license key is needed (from version 2023.11 or weekly releases); additional users and add-ons require the beta program or paid licensing
The README says on-premise operation is hard to run performantly, securely and highly available, and suggests SaaS for most users
Developer community issue tracker is for developers only; no commercial support for community versions
keywords: run my own office collaboration server
